workflows.label: Article or guide
workflows.description: A complete article that answers a buyer question, grounded in your business facts and measured demand.
workflows.prompt: Write an article or guide.

workflows.label: Blog post
workflows.description: A timely post with a clear point of view, written in your voice.
workflows.prompt: Write a blog post.

workflows.label: Landing or service page
workflows.description: A page that explains an offer, who it is for and the next step, without inventing proof.
workflows.prompt: Write a landing or service page.

workflows.label: Refresh an existing page
workflows.description: Update a page that is losing traffic or AI mentions, keeping what already works.
workflows.prompt: Refresh an existing page.

workflows.label: Comparison page
workflows.description: An honest comparison or alternatives page for named competitors.
workflows.prompt: Write a comparison page.

workflows.label: FAQ page
workflows.description: Answers to the questions buyers actually ask, taken from your demand and AI answers.
workflows.prompt: Write an FAQ page.

workflows.label: LinkedIn post
workflows.description: A short professional post with one clear idea.
workflows.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post.

workflows.label: X post or thread
workflows.description: A concise post or thread built from one strong point.
workflows.prompt: Write an X post or thread.

workflows.label: YouTube script
workflows.description: A video script with a hook, sections and on-screen notes.
workflows.prompt: Write a YouTube script.

workflows.label: Short video script
workflows.description: A TikTok, Reels or Shorts script that lands one point fast.
workflows.prompt: Write a short video script for TikTok, Reels or Shorts.

workflows.label: Reddit or forum answer
workflows.description: A genuinely helpful answer that discloses your affiliation.
workflows.prompt: Write a Reddit or forum answer.

workflows.label: Improve a page's search traffic
workflows.description: Exact edits for a page, based on the queries Search Console shows it for.
workflows.prompt: Suggest exact edits to improve this page's search traffic.

workflows.label: Internal links
workflows.description: Where to link from, with anchor text, to support an important page.
workflows.prompt: Plan internal links.

workflows.label: Fix a technical issue
workflows.description: Diagnose a crawl, indexing or AI-access problem and plan the fix.
workflows.prompt: Diagnose our most important technical issue and plan the fix.

inputs.label: Issue or page, if you have one

workflows.label: Why AI answers miss us
workflows.description: Find why AI engines leave you out or misdescribe you, and what to change.
workflows.prompt: Diagnose why AI answers miss or misdescribe us, and what to change.

inputs.label: Question or topic to focus on

workflows.label: Earn third-party mentions
workflows.description: Specific publications and pages to pitch, correct or contribute to.
workflows.prompt: Find third-party sources we should be mentioned in, with a pitch for each.

workflows.label: Track a niche
workflows.description: Buyer questions for a place, persona or constraint the general prompt set misses.
workflows.prompt: Propose buyer questions to track for a niche.

workflows.label: What to do next
workflows.description: A short, prioritized plan from your current Actions and data.
workflows.prompt: What should we focus on next? Give a prioritized plan.

workflows.label: Find content gaps
workflows.description: Topics and questions with real demand that your site does not answer yet.
workflows.prompt: Find the content gaps with the most commercial value.

workflows.label: Measure a change
workflows.description: How to tell whether a change worked, with the baseline and the check date.
workflows.prompt: Plan how to measure the result of a change.

workflows.label: Programmatic pages pilot
workflows.description: A small, quality-gated pilot for a repeatable page family.
workflows.prompt: Design a small programmatic pages pilot.
